mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties; perampanel is a CYP3A4 substrate and may increase oxybutynin metabolism, while additive anticholinergic effects and CNS depression can occur.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, cognitive changes) and CNS depression; consider dose adjustment or alternative agents if adverse effects emerge.
